In front of more than 1,200 teachers, a national education forum invited me to speak last spring. In 2022, the GYF selected me as one of 30 fellows in its Youth Fellowship for community leaders.

In September 2017, I was elected head of the student union at my faculty. I noticed that most students had never written a CV, so I designed a workshop series for 100 students. To date, we have trained more than 3,000 students.

Most importantly, I want every young person in my community to have the chance I had.
